subject: general
question: Mahabalipuram temple was built under the reign of which of the following dynasties?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pallava**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Mahabalipuram temple** was built under the reign of the **Pallava dynasty**.
 
• Mahabalipuram, also known as Mamallapuram, is a historic city and UNESCO World Heritage site located in Tamil Nadu, India.
 
• T
